description: Runs each thread on the Claude account you choose: a work account for one project, a personal one for another. Set a default for all projects and one per project, or pick a different account in the new-thread composer. An account can be a Claude config folder, a claude setup-token token or an Anthropic Console API key. Settings shows each login's plan and how much of its 5-hour and weekly limits is used, and flags a revoked login. A running thread can switch accounts and keep its conversation. Requires Claude Code; usage isn't reported for setup-tokens or API keys.
